decisions.reason: As a flagship launch tied to the firm's announced move into more complex packaging wafers and built on core wafer-processing capabilities, management is likely to justify continued commitment and treat any weak uptake as temporary.

The new off-the-shelf brand represents a visible public commitment, fits closely with the existing product base, and can be defended as a strategic channel extension worth sustaining despite any early disappointment.

Glass-based circuit boards are more distant from the firm's narrow core offer and less visibly central than the flagship lines, so management is more likely to stop them and redirect resources to established substrates and nearer-term developments.
